purpose: Teach: 前置き/受け取ら/訊い/知らず/さらっ/今時/騒ぐ/めくっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが前置きを丁寧にされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, back when I was young—your father had such careful ways about him.
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Slight pause after the dash, as if reaching back through time. Slow, deliberate pacing. Voice carries both warmth and a kind of quiet wondering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お給料を直接受け取らせていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—Grandpa, and he always had you handle the payroll directly, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing smile in her voice. Light, almost teasing affection on "dear." A beat of shared memory. Conversational, not hurried.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんに「結婚するか?」と訊いたぞ
lines.en: Gran, back when I was young—I asked your father once, "Will you marry me?"
lines.style: Soft vulnerability beneath the wistfulness. The question itself lands gently. Slight tremor of emotion on the memory, though held steady.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ばあさんが知らずに招いたお客様に、お茶を出されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa—and I served tea to a guest I hadn't even known you'd invited, didn't I, dear?
lines.style: Playful, slightly exasperated affection. Gently teasing him for remembering these moments. "Dear" carries both fondness and gentle reproof.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがおにぎりをさらっとお作りになったぞ
lines.en: Gran, back when I was young—your father made onigiri with such ease and grace.
lines.style: Reverent, admiring. The word "ease" lands softly—it's not just about the skill, it's about the lightness he brought to it. Long, thoughtful breath after the dash.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、今時の若者を心配されてたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa—and you were always so worried about young people these days, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle, knowing contradiction. Almost affectionate mockery—catching him in his habitual worry. Warm, steady, like she's calling him home to himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと孫が一緒に騒ぐ姿、覚えてるぞ
lines.en: Gran, back when I was young—I can still see your father and the grandchildren making noise together.
lines.style: Quiet joy underlying the wistfulness. The memory is vivid and alive in his voice. Slight lilt when naming the image. Holds the moment carefully, like something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ご本のページを、ゆっくりめくっていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa—and you used to turn the pages of your books so slowly and carefully, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Tender, intimate knowing. Speaks as if describing someone absorbed in thought. "Slowly" lands with gentle affection. Trailing softness on "dear"—intimate, not performative.
